description: Canonical merge, CI, and branch policy for the ICN monorepo. Agents must not hardcode these values — read this file.

merge.exception: Subtree merge commits (git subtree add --squash) must use --merge. State reason explicitly.
merge.agent_tooling_check_note: Runs on all PRs via .github/workflows/agent-drift-check.yml. Add to GitHub branch protection via: gh api repos/InterCooperative-Network/icn/branches/main/protection to make merge-blocking.

admin_bypass.summary: Only when the PR has no conflict, no required check has failed, and a required check's runner is queue-stalled. Never to defeat a failing gate.
admin_bypass.field_note: `MERGEABLE` is a value of the `mergeable` field (GraphQL `MergeableState`: MERGEABLE | CONFLICTING | UNKNOWN). `mergeStateStatus` is a DIFFERENT enum (`MergeStateStatus`: DIRTY | UNKNOWN | BLOCKED | BEHIND | UNSTABLE | HAS_HOOKS | CLEAN) and never takes the value MERGEABLE. Until icn#2656 this condition read `mergeStateStatus=MERGEABLE`, which no PR can ever satisfy, so the documented exception was unreachable as written. Re-verify with: gh api graphql -f query='{__type(name:"MergeStateStatus"){enumValues{name}}}'
admin_bypass.fail_closed: If any field above is absent, UNKNOWN, or ambiguous, do NOT bypass. Absence of evidence that a runner is stalled is not evidence that it is.

auto_merge.use_when: A required check is still pending (not failed)
auto_merge.note: Structured on purpose: there is no baked command string here. Until icn#2656 this field read `gh pr merge <N> --auto --squash`, duplicating default_strategy — changing the strategy in one place would have left the other silently wrong. Compose the command as `gh pr merge <N> ${gh_flags} --${default_strategy}`. Never shell-eval a value from this file.

readiness_definition: All 11 required CI checks passed (includes Agent Tooling Drift Check)
Branch is up-to-date with main (strict mode)
mergeStateStatus is MERGEABLE or UNSTABLE (UNSTABLE = non-blocking checks only)

workspace.note: Run cargo from icn/ (the Cargo workspace root, contains Cargo.toml). The repo root itself has no Cargo.toml.
